# Wattlyst

> Wattlyst (https://wattlyst.com/) makes free electricity calculators for homes: watts and amps conversions, battery and UPS backup, generator sizing, solar systems, home load and Pakistan electricity bills. Electricity math, done right. Every result shows its formula and assumptions; all calculators run in the browser.

## Sections

- [Appliance Wattage List: Watts and Units per Hour](https://wattlyst.com/appliances/): Running watts, starting watts and units per hour for 60+ home appliances: ACs, fans, fridges, motors, irons, geysers and more.
- [Electrical Unit Converters](https://wattlyst.com/converters/): Free electrical converters for watts, amps, volts, kW, kVA, VA and amp hours. Each tool shows the formula with your numbers for DC, single and three phase.
- [Battery and UPS Calculators](https://wattlyst.com/battery/): Battery and UPS calculators for homes: backup time, battery bank size and runtime for 12V, 24V and 48V systems, with tubular and lithium battery options.
- [Generator Calculators](https://wattlyst.com/generator/): Generator calculators for home and appliances: running and starting watts, kVA size, AC and water pump loads, and fuel use, with each step shown.
- [Solar Calculators](https://wattlyst.com/solar/): Solar calculators for homes: system size, panels, batteries, inverter, charge controller and net billing, using real sun hours for cities in Pakistan.
- [Home Load Calculators](https://wattlyst.com/load/): Load calculators for homes: total watts, single phase load, AC units per hour, monthly units and running cost, to plan before adding new appliances.
- [Electricity Bill Calculators](https://wattlyst.com/bill/): Electricity bill calculators for LESCO, IESCO, MEPCO, K-Electric and every DISCO in Pakistan, using 2026 tariff slabs, taxes and fixed charges with dates.
- [Wiring Calculators](https://wattlyst.com/wiring/): Wiring calculators for wire size, MCB breaker size, solar DC cable and voltage drop. Always confirm final wiring with a licensed electrician.
- [Electricity Guides](https://wattlyst.com/guides/): Plain-English electricity guides: net billing in Pakistan, peak hours, FPA charges, lithium vs tubular batteries and inverter vs UPS explained.
- [Troubleshooting Tools](https://wattlyst.com/troubleshoot/): Troubleshooting tools for home power systems: look up solar inverter error codes and plan battery series and parallel wiring safely, step by step.
- [Pakistan Electricity Data](https://wattlyst.com/data/): Original Pakistan electricity data: a monthly bill index for every DISCO and a solar price tracker, each with a chart, the method and a CSV download.

## Start here

- [Home Power Planner: Free Electricity Calculators](https://wattlyst.com/): Plan your home power with free calculators for load, battery backup, solar size, generators, wiring and bills. Every formula is shown.

## Calculators

- [Watts to Amps Calculator for DC, Single-Phase and Three-Phase](https://wattlyst.com/converters/watts-to-amps-calculator/): Convert watts to amps for DC, single-phase and three-phase circuits. Pick 12V, 230V or any voltage, add power factor and see the formula with your numbers.
- [Amps to Watts Calculator (DC, AC and 3-Phase)](https://wattlyst.com/converters/amps-to-watts-calculator/): Convert amps to watts for DC, single-phase or three-phase supply. Enter current, voltage and power factor; get watts with a step-by-step formula.
- [12V Watts to Amps Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/converters/12v-watts-to-amps-calculator/): Find how many amps a 12V load draws from your battery. Includes inverter losses, a 12V reference table and examples for fans, lights and routers.
- [230V and 220V Watts to Amps Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/converters/230v-watts-to-amps-calculator/): Convert watts to amps on 230V or 220V mains. Power factor included, with a table for common appliances like ACs, irons and water motors.
- [3 Phase Amps Calculator (kW and kVA to Amps)](https://wattlyst.com/converters/3-phase-current-calculator/): Calculate three-phase current from kW or kVA at 400V or any line voltage. Uses I = P / (√3 × V × PF) and shows each step with your values.
- [Amps to kW Calculator (and kW to Amps)](https://wattlyst.com/converters/amps-to-kw-calculator/): Convert amps to kilowatts and back for DC, single-phase and three-phase supply. Add power factor, see the formula and a quick reference table.
- [Volts to Watts Calculator (Volts × Amps)](https://wattlyst.com/converters/volts-to-watts-calculator/): Turn volts and amps into watts for DC or AC circuits. Includes power factor for AC loads and worked examples for 12V, 24V and 230V.
- [kVA to kW Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/converters/kva-to-kw-calculator/): Convert kVA to kW using power factor. See why a 5 kVA generator or UPS gives about 4 kW at PF 0.8, with a table for common sizes.
- [VA to Watts Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/converters/va-to-watts-calculator/): Convert a UPS or inverter VA rating to real watts using power factor. Find how many watts a 1000VA or 1500VA UPS can actually run.
- [Amp Hours to Watt Hours (Ah to Wh) Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/converters/ah-to-wh-calculator/): Convert battery amp-hours to watt-hours or kWh, and back. Pick 12V, 24V, 48V or 51.2V lithium and see usable energy after depth of discharge.
- [Battery Backup Time Calculator for Home](https://wattlyst.com/battery/battery-backup-time-calculator/): How long will your home UPS battery last? Enter load, battery Ah and type (tubular or lithium) to get backup time with inverter losses included.
- [12V Battery Runtime Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/battery/12v-battery-runtime-calculator/): Find how long a 12V battery runs your load. Works for 100Ah, 150Ah and 200Ah, lead-acid or lithium, with DC and inverter loads.
- [200Ah Battery Backup Time Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/battery/200ah-battery-backup-time-calculator/): See how many hours a 200Ah battery runs fans, lights, a fridge or a PC. Tubular and lithium, 12V or 24V, with a ready backup time table.
- [Battery Capacity Calculator for Appliances](https://wattlyst.com/battery/battery-bank-size-calculator/): Pick your appliances and backup hours to get the battery Ah and how many batteries you need for a 1kW, 3kW or 5kW inverter. Tubular and lithium.
- [UPS Backup Time Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/battery/ups-backup-time-calculator/): Estimate UPS runtime for a PC, router or CCTV from VA rating, battery Ah and load. Includes power factor and real inverter efficiency.
- [Generator Size for Well Pump](https://wattlyst.com/generator/generator-for-well-pump/): Find the generator size for a 0.5 to 5 HP well or water pump. Converts HP to watts, adds motor starting surge and gives kVA at PF 0.8.
- [Generator Size for 1.5 Ton AC](https://wattlyst.com/generator/generator-for-1-5-ton-ac/): What kVA generator runs a 1.5 ton inverter or non-inverter AC? Running and starting watts, kVA at PF 0.8, and home load examples.
- [What Can a 5 kVA Generator Run?](https://wattlyst.com/generator/what-can-a-kva-generator-run/): See which appliances a 3, 5 or 7 kVA generator can run at once, with real watts at PF 0.8 and motor starting surge. Try your own list.
- [Solar Battery Size Calculator for Home](https://wattlyst.com/solar/solar-battery-size-calculator/): Size the battery bank for your solar system from night-time load, backup days and battery type. Lithium and tubular, 12V to 48V.
- [Solar Panel Wattage Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/solar/solar-panel-wattage-calculator/): Find the total solar panel watts you need from daily kWh and your city's sun hours. Losses included; shows the number of 585W panels.
- [Off-Grid Solar System Size Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/solar/off-grid-solar-calculator/): Plan a full off-grid solar system: panels, battery bank, inverter and charge controller from your appliance list and backup days.
- [Inverter Size Calculator for Home Appliances](https://wattlyst.com/solar/inverter-size-calculator/): Find the inverter or UPS size in watts and kVA for your appliances, including AC and motor starting surge. Can a UPS run a 1 ton AC?
- [How Many Solar Panels Do I Need to Run an AC?](https://wattlyst.com/solar/solar-panels-to-run-ac/): Find the solar panels, inverter and battery to run a 1 or 1.5 ton inverter AC in Pakistan. Uses your city's sun hours and real AC watts.
- [Solar Panel Calculator for 12V Battery](https://wattlyst.com/solar/solar-panel-for-12v-battery/): What size solar panel charges a 100Ah or 200Ah 12V battery? Includes charge controller type, sun hours and charging losses.
- [Solar System Size for Daily kWh Usage](https://wattlyst.com/solar/solar-system-size-calculator/): Turn your daily kWh usage or monthly units into solar system size in kW, panel count and roof space, using real sun data for your city.
- [Solar System for 5 Marla House](https://wattlyst.com/solar/solar-system-for-5-marla-house/): How many kW solar does a 5 marla house need? Typical load, panels, inverter, battery and cost, plus a calculator for your own bill.
- [Net Billing Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/solar/net-billing-calculator/): Compare your bill under old net metering and the 2026 net billing rules. Enter solar kW, units used and exported; see savings in PKR.
- [10 Marla Solar System: Size, Panels and Inverter](https://wattlyst.com/solar/solar-system-for-10-marla-house/): Typical 10 marla load, the right solar system size in kW, panels, inverter and battery, plus cost and payback. Use the calculator for your bill.
- [1 Kanal Solar System: Size for a House with 3 to 4 ACs](https://wattlyst.com/solar/solar-system-for-1-kanal-house/): How much solar does a 1 kanal house need with 3 to 4 ACs? kW, panels, hybrid inverter, battery options and cost estimate.
- [Solar System Price in Pakistan: 3kW, 5kW and 10kW Systems](https://wattlyst.com/solar/solar-system-price-pakistan/): Estimated price of 3kW, 5kW and 10kW on-grid and hybrid solar systems in Pakistan, part by part, with the date checked and payback.
- [Tubewell Solar System Calculator: HP to kW](https://wattlyst.com/solar/tubewell-solar-calculator/): Size a solar system for a 1 to 20 HP tubewell or water pump: panel kW, VFD inverter and daily water hours. For farmers in Pakistan.
- [Solar Charge Controller Size Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/solar/charge-controller-size-calculator/): Find the amp rating of your PWM or MPPT solar charge controller from panel watts and battery voltage, with a safety margin and cold-weather Voc.
- [Home Electrical Load Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/load/home-electrical-load-calculator/): Add your home appliances to get total watts, peak load, amps and daily units. Pakistani and US appliance lists, then size your UPS or solar.
- [Appliance Load Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/load/appliance-load-calculator/): Find watts, daily units and monthly bill share for any appliance. Choose from a list of common home appliances or enter your own rating.
- [Single Phase Load Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/load/single-phase-load-calculator/): Check if your single-phase 230V connection can handle your load. Total kW, amps, diversity factor and sanctioned load check.
- [Home Load Calculator Before Adding an AC](https://wattlyst.com/load/load-before-adding-ac/): Check your current load, meter and wiring before adding a 1 or 1.5 ton AC. Shows new total amps, sanctioned load and wire size needed.
- [1.5 Ton Inverter AC Unit Consumption per Hour in Pakistan](https://wattlyst.com/load/ac-units-calculator/): How many units does a 1.5 ton inverter AC use per hour in Pakistan? See unit consumption per hour, per day and the monthly AC bill in PKR.
- [Unit Calculator for Electricity](https://wattlyst.com/load/unit-calculator/): Convert watts or amps and hours into electricity units (kWh), where 1 unit = 1 kWh. Find daily and monthly units and cost for any appliance.
- [Electricity Bill Calculator Pakistan](https://wattlyst.com/bill/electricity-bill-calculator-pakistan/): Calculate your electricity bill with the latest NEPRA tariff, taxes and FPA. Protected consumer check, slab warning and all DISCOs.

- [Wire Size Calculator Pakistan](https://wattlyst.com/wiring/wire-size-calculator/): Find the right copper wire size for any load and length. Shows mm² and Pakistani 3/29, 7/29, 7/36 sizes with ampere ratings and voltage drop.
- [MCB Size Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/wiring/breaker-size-calculator/): Pick the right MCB size and curve (B, C, D) for lights, sockets, ACs and motors from load watts. Wire and breaker matched safely.
- [DC Cable Size for Solar Panels](https://wattlyst.com/wiring/solar-cable-size-calculator/): Size the DC cable from solar panels to inverter and battery for 3kW to 10kW systems. Keeps voltage drop under 3% with a safety margin.
- [Voltage Drop Calculator for Any Cable, AC or DC](https://wattlyst.com/wiring/voltage-drop-calculator/): Calculate voltage drop for any wire size, length and load, single or three phase, DC or AC. See if your cable stays under 3% or 5%.
- [Fan Units per Hour in Pakistan: AC Fan vs DC Inverter Fan](https://wattlyst.com/appliances/ceiling-fan/): How many units does a ceiling fan use per hour in Pakistan? Normal AC fan vs DC inverter fan, with daily units, monthly bill and UPS backup.

- [Solar Inverter Error Codes and What to Do](https://wattlyst.com/troubleshoot/inverter-error-codes/): Look up your solar inverter error code and see what it means and how to fix it safely. Inverex, Growatt, Nitrox, Crown, Fronus and more.
- [Solar Quotation Checker: Is the Price Fair?](https://wattlyst.com/solar/solar-quote-checker/): Enter your solar quotation (kW, panels, inverter, price) to see the cost per watt, what is missing and whether the price fits today's market.
- [Sanctioned Load Calculator](https://wattlyst.com/bill/sanctioned-load-calculator/): Find the sanctioned load in kW your home needs from its appliances, see the 5 kW ToU meter limit and the solar net billing size cap.
- [Inverter AC Heating Cost vs Gas and Electric Heaters](https://wattlyst.com/load/winter-heating-cost-calculator/): Compare the cost per hour of heating with an inverter AC in heat mode, a gas heater and an electric heater, using your tariff and gas price.
- [Solar Output Forecast Tomorrow for Your City](https://wattlyst.com/solar/solar-forecast-tomorrow/): See how many units your solar system should make today and tomorrow in your city, based on the weather forecast and your system size.
- [UPS vs Solar vs Generator: Cost Over Five Years](https://wattlyst.com/load/ups-vs-solar-vs-generator-cost/): Compare the 5-year cost of a UPS, solar system and generator for your load and loadshedding hours: purchase, fuel, batteries and bills.

## Guides

- [FPA in Electricity Bill: What It Means and How to Calculate It](https://wattlyst.com/guides/fpa-in-electricity-bill/): What fuel price adjustment (FPA) means on your bill, this month's rate with the NEPRA decision link, and how to calculate it yourself.
- [Lithium vs Tubular Battery: Backup, Life and Cost](https://wattlyst.com/guides/lithium-vs-tubular-battery/): Lithium vs tubular battery compared on usable backup, cycle life, charging, price per usable kWh and which suits loadshedding.
- [Inverter vs UPS: Which One for Your Home?](https://wattlyst.com/guides/inverter-vs-ups/): The real difference between a UPS, an inverter and a hybrid solar inverter, with switching time, efficiency and which loads each can run.

## Data (CC BY 4.0, CSV download on each page)

- [Pakistan Electricity Bill Index](https://wattlyst.com/data/pakistan-electricity-bill-index/): Monthly bill for 100, 200, 300 and 500 units in LESCO, IESCO, K-Electric and every DISCO, with the change from last month, method and a free CSV download.
- [Pakistan Solar Price Tracker](https://wattlyst.com/data/pakistan-solar-price-tracker/): Monthly tracker of solar system, panel, inverter and battery prices in Pakistan from dated dealer price lists, with sources, a chart and a CSV download.

## Method, data and policies

- [About Wattlyst](https://wattlyst.com/about/): Wattlyst builds free electricity calculators for homes, solar and bills. Meet the founder, see how the tools are made and how to reach us with corrections.
- [Methodology](https://wattlyst.com/methodology/): How Wattlyst calculators get their numbers: formulas, default values, data sources and checks, with every assumption listed so you can verify each result.
- [Editorial Policy](https://wattlyst.com/editorial-policy/): How Wattlyst writes, checks and updates its electricity guides and calculators, how AI assistance is reviewed by a human, and how to report an error.
- [Contact Us](https://wattlyst.com/contact/): Email the Wattlyst team with questions, data corrections or feedback on any calculator. Include the page link and the number you think is wrong.
- [Privacy Policy](https://wattlyst.com/privacy-policy/): How Wattlyst handles your data: calculator inputs stay in your browser, which cookies analytics and Google ads may use, and how to opt out or contact us.
- [Terms of Use](https://wattlyst.com/terms/): The terms for using Wattlyst calculators and guides: free estimates for planning, no warranty, your responsibility for final decisions, and outside links.
- [Disclaimer](https://wattlyst.com/disclaimer/): Wattlyst results are estimates for planning, not an official bill, quote or engineer sign-off. Confirm wiring and solar work with a licensed electrician.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Results are planning estimates, not official bills or engineering sign-off. Defaults are listed at https://wattlyst.com/methodology/.
- Pakistan defaults: 230 V single phase, 400 V three phase, 50 Hz, prices in PKR. Tariff data last checked 2026-10-13.
- Contact for corrections: contact@wattlyst.com.
